question: At 14:00 local time, determine whether enforcement is allowed. A valid accessible permit controls despite the visual curb marking.

evidence.content: Synthetic SVG: vehicle is beside a faded red curb marking.
Permit P-006 is valid 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31 and explicitly authorizes this vehicle in the marked space.
Visual marking normally prohibits parking, except for an active permit listed in the permit registry.

gold_answer.reason: The active permit is an explicit exception to the visual curb restriction, so enforcement is not allowed.
